result.stdout:
USAGE:
    dbshift [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    new         Scaffold a complete DbShift project structure in the current    
                directory                                                       
    init        Create the migration tracking schema on the target database     
    validate    Validate migration scripts (naming, syntax, duplicates,         
                dependencies)                                                   
    status      Show the migration status for an environment                    
    plan        Compute and display the pending migration execution plan        
                (dry-run)                                                       
    migrate     Apply pending migrations to the target environment              
    rollback    Roll back one or more previously applied migrations             
    repair      Repair the migration history (re-queue a failed migration)      
    history     Show the audit history for an environment                       
    create      Scaffold a new migration script from a template                 
    info        Show configuration, environments and repository details

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Scaffold a complete DbShift project structure in the current directory.

USAGE:
    dbshift new [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                 Prints help information                          
    -v, --version              Prints version information                       
    -e, --environment          Target environment                               
    -p, --provider             Database provider: postgresql | sqlserver | mysql
                               | sqlite                                         
    -c, --connection-string    Database connection string override              
    -C, --base-path            Path to the repository root (config base)        
    -i, --in-memory            Force offline in-memory mode (no database)       
    -y, --yes                  Skip interactive prompts                         
        --no-color             Disable colored output                           
    -j, --json                 Emit machine-readable JSON                       
    -v, --verbose              Show detailed informational output               
    -m, --module               Module name (subfolder under                     
                               Database/Migrations/)                            
    -n, --name                 Project name (used in example migrations and CI) 
    -o, --output               Output directory (default: current directory)    
    -f, --force                Overwrite existing files
